description: Manage Omni dashboards, folders, and labels, and run saved queries.

omni_new_document_trigger.description: Runs for each new document in Omni. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields _count.favorites, _count.views, connectionId, deleted, folder.id, folder.name, folder.path, folder.scope, hasApp, hasDashboard, identifier, labels, lastViewedAt, name, description, owner.id, owner.name, scope, updatedAt, url, visits

omni_new_folder_trigger.description: Runs for each new folder in Omni. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, path, scope, owner.id, owner.name, labels, _count.documents, _count.favorites, url

omni_new_label_trigger.description: Runs for each new label in Omni. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields name, verified, homepage, usage_count, color, description
